task: Let charts/nfs-quota-agent pin the agent image by digest for a reproducible, air-gap-safe install (part of #5)

events.summary: Issue #5's discussion log records an AI-assisted triage pass and a Gemini(agy)-authored design proposal, both reviewed by the maintainer before this lane started. The triage listed 'no offline image bundle / no artifact signing / no upgrade-rollback E2E / hand-maintained compat matrix' as the genuine remaining gaps. The Gemini design proposal's section 2 ('Container Image Digest Pinning Strategy') is what this lane implements: values.yaml image.digest field, an nfs-quota-agent.image helper rendering repository@digest when set, and a hack/update-chart-digest.py script -- taken as a starting design, not copied uncritically (see e3 for where this lane's implementation diverges from that proposal)
events.provenance: gh issue view 5 --comments (dasomel/nfs-quota-agent, maintainer-authored comments plus one explicitly labelled AI-assisted triage and one explicitly labelled Gemini/agy design proposal)

events.summary: Scoped to chart digest pinning only: values.yaml, templates/_helpers.tpl, README's values table, a new hack/update-chart-digest.py plus its test, a Makefile target, and this trace. Explicitly out of scope and left untouched: .github/workflows/release.yaml (wiring the script into the release pipeline is a later, sequential lane -- this PR only adds the capability), values.schema.json (does not exist in this repo; digest format validation is done with a helper-level `fail` instead, see e3), RBAC, privilege, and CRDs (unrelated to this change)

Defect framed honestly: before this change, charts/nfs-quota-agent could only reference the agent image by a mutable tag (repository:tag, tag defaulting to Chart.AppVersion) -- so an air-gapped install had no way to pin the exact image content that hack/verify-release.py already verifies by digest in release-manifest.json, and a tag could be silently re-pushed to point at different content after the fact. Fix: values.yaml gains image.digest (default "", comment documents the contract); templates/_helpers.tpl's nfs-quota-agent.image renders `repository@sha256:...` when digest is set (dropping tag entirely rather than combining as repository:tag@digest, to match the `<repository>@<digest>` shape hack/verify-release.py's own docstring already uses -- avoids two different canonical spellings of a pinned image existing in this repo) and validates the digest against ^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$ with Helm's `fail`, since this chart has no values.schema.json for that job. Diverges from the Gemini proposal in e1 in two ways found during implementation: (1) it proposed repository@digest as a bare replacement with no format guard; this lane added the regex `fail` because a malformed digest would otherwise reach the container runtime as an invalid reference with a much less clear error; (2) it proposed editing templates/daemonset.yaml directly, but that template already renders the image via `include "nfs-quota-agent.image" .`, so the helper change alone is sufficient and daemonset.yaml needed no edit. hack/update-chart-digest.py (stdlib-only, argparse) resolves a digest via crane, skopeo, or `docker buildx imagetools inspect` (first available on PATH) or accepts one directly with --digest, then idempotently rewrites only the `digest:` line inside values.yaml's `image:` block via regex, preserving every comment and the rest of the file byte-for-byte -- deliberately not a YAML-library round-trip, matching hack/validate-compatibility-matrix.py's documented stdlib-only rule for this directory. A `make update-chart-digest` target (DIGEST=... or IMAGE=..., VALUES_FILE=... override) wraps it. Chart.yaml version bumped 0.4.0 -> 0.4.1 (patch, backward-compatible feature addition), matching every prior chart-touching commit's pattern of bumping `version`; appVersion untouched

Before the fix, `helm template charts/nfs-quota-agent --set image.digest=sha256:<64hex>` had no effect on the rendered image line at all (image.digest was not a recognized key, so Helm silently ignored it and rendered repository:tag as always) -- confirmed by checking out charts/nfs-quota-agent/templates/_helpers.tpl at origin/main (git archive origin/main) into a scratch directory and rendering it with the same --set flag: the image line came back unchanged as `ghcr.io/dasomel/nfs-quota-agent:0.3.0`, silently discarding the operator's intent to pin

helm lint charts/nfs-quota-agent: 0 chart(s) failed. helm template charts/nfs-quota-agent (default values) diffed against the same render from a git-archive checkout of origin/main's chart directory: identical except 7 `helm.sh/chart: nfs-quota-agent-0.4.0` label lines that read `nfs-quota-agent-0.4.1` instead -- the expected, sole consequence of this PR's Chart.yaml version bump (0.4.0 -> 0.4.1), not a digest-pinning behavior change; the rendered image line itself (repository:tag) is unchanged for the unset-digest case. helm template --set image.digest=sha256:<64 valid hex> renders `image: ghcr.io/dasomel/nfs-quota-agent@sha256:<...>`, dropping the tag as designed. helm template --set image.digest=sha256:badhash fails render with 'is not a valid sha256 digest' pointing at daemonset.yaml:60 (no values.schema.json exists in this chart, so this Helm-level `fail` is the enforcement point instead). python3 -m pytest hack/: 27 passed, 2 subtests passed, including the 14 new tests in hack/test_update_chart_digest.py covering --digest write/idempotency/replace/invalid-format/missing-key/missing-file/mutually-exclusive-args and --image resolution via stub crane/skopeo/docker (preference order, fallthrough on tool failure, clear error when none present). make help lists the new update-chart-digest target; make update-chart-digest DIGEST=sha256:<64hex> VALUES_FILE=<temp copy> correctly wrote the digest into a temp copy of values.yaml, and the same target with neither DIGEST nor IMAGE set fails with the intended $(error) message. No .go files changed by this PR (git diff --name-only has zero .go matches), so make test/vet and gofmt -l . were not re-run for this change beyond confirming that zero-file count directly
events.scope: chart rendering (default/digest-set/invalid-digest cases), the new hack script's CLI contract end-to-end via subprocess tests plus one manual make-target smoke test against a real temp values.yaml copy, and confirming no Go surface was touched; does not cover pulling an image by digest from a real registry or a real cluster

events.summary: Part of #5 is advanced by this PR: the chart can now pin its image by digest (values.yaml image.digest, nfs-quota-agent.image helper, format validation, docs, and a resolve/write helper script), at the evidence level in e5. Wiring this into .github/workflows/release.yaml so a release automatically pins the digest is intentionally left for a later, sequential lane per the scope stated in e2 -- #5 as a whole is not closed by this PR alone

Complete for the scope in e2 (chart-side digest pinning capability plus its resolve/write tooling), verified at the level in e5. Not yet verified: pulling an image by digest from a real registry or a real cluster, and the release-pipeline wiring is deliberately deferred to a follow-up lane rather than left half-done here
